name: huante-skills
description: Personal Claude Code skills by Edgar Huante.

plugins.name: pr-fix
plugins.description: Implement the changes requested in a GitHub pull request's code review: understand the project, fix each comment with the minimal change, validate, report. Never commits or pushes on its own.

plugins.name: test-changes
plugins.description: Create and run the tests for the changes just implemented (Vitest, Amplify Gen 2 + React + TypeScript): detects the git change set, tests only the new or modified behavior, runs tests, TypeScript and coverage.

plugins.name: spec-flow
plugins.description: Turn an informal change request into one or more small, project-grounded specs (split by functional change, reviewed for architecture and design) written in Spanish under docs/ggin-N/specs/feat/ggin-N/<slug>.md with branch feat/ggin-N/<slug>, compatible with /spec and /spec-impl, then stop for review before any implementation.
